event_types.name: REQUEST_RECEIVED
event_types.description: The orchestrator has received and validated the incoming request.

event_types.name: AGENT_STARTED
event_types.description: A specific agent has begun processing.

event_types.name: SOURCE_RETRIEVED
event_types.description: The agent has retrieved evidence from the Knowledge service.

event_types.name: AGENT_PROCESSING
event_types.description: The agent is actively processing (LLM inference in progress).

event_types.name: AGENT_FAILED
event_types.description: The agent encountered an unrecoverable error.

event_types.name: WARNING
event_types.description: A non-fatal condition (e.g. low confidence, missing optional evidence).

event_types.name: FINAL_RESULT
event_types.description: The orchestrator emits the final aggregated result for this agent_run_id.
